Sherry FitzGerald Madden are delighted to bring to the market this luxurious family home.

Ideally located just 5km from Portumna Town, the property enjoys easy access to a wide range of social, recreational, and everyday amenities. Portumna Forest Park is a short distance away, offering beautiful woodland trails, lakeside walks, cycling routes, and a host of outdoor activities, making this an ideal location for those seeking both convenience and a tranquil lifestyle.

Presented for sale in excellent condition this energy efficient home boasts bright and spacious accommodation with all rooms of generous proportions. One has the opportunity here to acquire a very well presented, spacious and comfortable family home in a most attractive location.

There are numerous choices of primary schools within a 6km radius, Killeen NS 3km, Gortanummera NS 2km, St. Brendans NS Portumna 6km, Abbey National School 8km Post primary school options include Portumna Community School 6km or Mercy College Woodford 13km.

Viewing of this property is highly recommended and can be arranged by appointment through selling agents.
